6.  23-24850  Recommendation to discuss Long Beach Municipal Code Section 8.68.066
  regarding smoking at municipal golf courses.

  A motion was made by Co-Chair Fitzgerald, seconded by Member Ricci, to
  approve recommendation, as amended, to recommend the Director of Parks,
  Recreation and Marine request City Council amend Long Beach Municipal
  Code Section 8.68.066 to allow smoking at municipal golf courses only in
  areas designated by the Director of Parks, Recreation and Marine. The
  motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  7  Conkings, Ricci, Young, Yun, Fitzgerald, Thrift, Barrett
